This app was working better before your update except not having the screen oriented properly.

Best Decision We Made. We signed up for WEAVE halfway through 2019 after my sister told me that it is a game changer.  I was skeptical after having worked with Birdseye and Solution Reach.  However, I was impressed at the deal we received as well as the month-to-month contract.  We have never looked back.  With COVID hitting less than a year after we signed up, WEAVE helped us stay connected with our team and patients even when the office was closed in observance of CDC guidance.  WEAVE quickly pivoted adding things like Wellness Forms and Curbside Waiting Room instructions to the library of templates making the transition back to the office much smoother than we anticipated.  The User interface is so easy to use and the accessibility is amazing.  The whole team loves it.  In addition, I’ve been so impressed with all the people at WEAVE.  I’ve been invited to give feedback and have had the opportunity to speak with the people who make changes to the software based on that feedback.  I’ve seen at least 5 of my recommendations be implemented within a year.  That’s crazy! If we could give 10 stars we would.
New to Weave. So far we are very pleased.  Fairly easy to use and no dropped calls that we are aware of.  Would like more training on it.  Only have had it a few weeks.

Large Optometric Practice Loving Weave! We started with Weave July 1st 2019, we are a large practice, 6 doctors,  30+ staff and to say, we do underestimated our phone traffic before Weave, would be a simple understatement. The first 4 hours live we had 300 calls! ( you can track your call volume, calls received, calls missed, what employees are actually answering calls) The fact that all calls are recorded has also helped with training of staff to help maintain the quality we want. Weave is constantly upgrading to offer new services and features to keep you in business, during the recent At&t outage, we were still able to communicate via text with patients thru our cell phones even though our internet was down. Weave is the future of Patient care. Main thing you need is to make sure you have a stable internet connection with tremendous upload speed or weave will not be able to work correctly!

I’m also able to see my schedule easily and receive and read efaxes. I’m also able to use the app to call patients without giving out my cell phone number—only the office number shows. Mostly Good with Room for Improvement. This app definitely has its good points but of course still has its glitches and room for improvement. We use it in our optometry practice to communicate with patients and each other.  Some things our office loves: Easy texting Automated texting Inter-office chat (much better since the recent update that lists new messages first) Phone trees It is easy to set voicemail overrides whenever needed Listening to voicemail on the computer Multiple lines for incoming calls on the phones   Some things that could use improvement:  Inter-office chat has some kinks such as not being able to mark a chat notice as read from the notification Incoming texts recently changed and are harder to navigate Glitches such as texts not going out or coming in on time (rare but can be very frustrating) Individual voicemail boxes would be super helpful Wish we could manage our own phone tree!!
